acceptance.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
acceptance.content: By accessing and using Accounting AI Agent ("the Service"), you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service. If you do not agree to these terms, please do not use the Service.

services.title: 2. Description of Services
services.content: Accounting AI Agent provides AI-powered accounting assistance, including but not limited to: financial data analysis, invoice management through wFirma integration, document generation, and AI chat functionality for accounting queries.

accounts.title: 3. User Accounts
accounts.content: You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account credentials. You agree to provide accurate information during registration and to update your information as needed. You are responsible for all activities that occur under your account.

apiKeys.title: 4. API Keys and Third-Party Services
apiKeys.content: You may provide your own API keys for AI providers (OpenAI, Anthropic). You are responsible for securing these keys and for any charges incurred through their use. We encrypt stored API keys but cannot guarantee absolute security.

wfirma.title: 5. wFirma Integration
wfirma.content: If you connect your wFirma account, you authorize us to access your wFirma data on your behalf. We will only access data necessary to provide the Service. You are responsible for ensuring you have the right to share this data with us.

intellectualProperty.title: 6. Intellectual Property
intellectualProperty.content: The Service and its original content, features, and functionality are owned by Accounting AI Agent and are protected by international copyright, trademark, and other intellectual property laws.

limitations.title: 7. Limitations of Liability
limitations.content: The Service is provided "as is" without warranties of any kind. We are not liable for any financial decisions made based on AI-generated advice. Always consult with a qualified accountant for important financial matters.

termination.title: 8. Termination
termination.content: We may terminate or suspend your account at any time, without prior notice, for conduct that violates these Terms or is harmful to other users or the Service.

changes.title: 9. Changes to Terms
changes.content: We reserve the right to modify these terms at any time. We will notify users of significant changes via email or through the Service.

contact.title: 10. Contact Information
contact.content: For questions about these Terms, please contact us through the application's chat feature or email support.

introduction.title: 1. Introduction
introduction.content: This Privacy Policy explains how Accounting AI Agent collects, uses, and protects your personal information when you use our Service.

dataCollection.title: 2. Information We Collect
dataCollection.content: We collect: account information (email, name), authentication data, API keys you provide (encrypted), wFirma data you authorize access to, conversation history with AI, and usage analytics.

dataUse.title: 3. How We Use Your Information
dataUse.content: We use your information to: provide and improve the Service, process your requests, communicate with you, ensure security, and comply with legal obligations.

dataStorage.title: 4. Data Storage and Retention
dataStorage.content: Your data is stored securely in our databases. API keys are encrypted using AES-256-GCM encryption. We retain your data for as long as your account is active or as needed to provide services.

thirdParties.title: 5. Third-Party Services
thirdParties.content: We integrate with third-party services including: AI providers (OpenAI, Anthropic), wFirma accounting system, OAuth providers (Google, GitHub). Each has their own privacy policies.

cookies.title: 6. Cookies and Tracking
cookies.content: We use essential cookies for authentication and session management. We may use analytics cookies to improve the Service. You can manage cookie preferences in your browser settings.

userRights.title: 7. Your Rights
userRights.content: You have the right to: access your personal data, correct inaccurate data, request deletion of your data, export your data, and withdraw consent for data processing.

security.title: 8. Security Measures
security.content: We implement industry-standard security measures including: encrypted data transmission (HTTPS), encrypted storage of sensitive data, secure authentication, and regular security audits.

children.title: 9. Children's Privacy
children.content: Our Service is not intended for users under 18 years of age. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children.

changes.title: 10. Changes to This Policy
changes.content: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of any changes by posting the new policy and updating the "Last updated" date.

contact.title: 11. Contact Us
contact.content: If you have questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us through the application's chat feature or email support.
